title: ZOA
description: Unified ZOA service dashboard: SLIs, Trusted Action executions, HTTP API, worker pipeline, and underlying Lambda/DLQ/DynamoDB infrastructure. Single pane of glass for on-call.

panels.title: TA Success Rate
panels.description: Succeeded / all terminal executions in the current CloudWatch period. SLO target: 95%. Alert fires when <95% with >10 executions for 15m; this panel may show low percentages during quiet periods without triggering an alert.

targets.expr: (sum(aws_zoa_execution_count_sum{dimension_Status="succeeded", cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Action=~"$action"}) / sum(aws_zoa_execution_count_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Action=~"$action"})) and on() (sum(aws_zoa_execution_count_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Action=~"$action"}) > 0)

panels.title: API Availability
panels.description: Non-5xx / total HTTP requests. SLO target: 99%. Excludes 4xx (client errors are expected: cooldown, validation). Alert fires when <99% with >10 requests for 15m; this panel may show low percentages during quiet periods without triggering an alert.

targets.expr: ((sum(aws_zoa_http_request_count_sum{dimension_HandlerMode="api", cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster"}) - (sum(aws_zoa_http_request_count_sum{dimension_HandlerMode="api", dimension_StatusClass="5xx", cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0))) / sum(aws_zoa_http_request_count_sum{dimension_HandlerMode="api", cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster"})) and on() (sum(aws_zoa_http_request_count_sum{dimension_HandlerMode="api", cluster=~"$cluster", dimension_Cluster=~"$cluster"}) > 0)

panels.title: Lambda Error Rate
panels.description: Lambda-level error rate across ZOA functions. Complements API availability — a Lambda error means the entire request was lost.

panels.title: Executions
panels.description: Terminal TA execution count in the current YACE CloudWatch window (~120s).

panels.title: P99 Sync TA
panels.description: P99 latency of sync Trusted Actions (in-Lambda execution). Async TAs run as K8s Jobs with longer deadlines — see P99 Async TA and Duration by Action.

panels.title: P99 Async TA
panels.description: P99 latency of async Trusted Actions (K8s Job-based). Minutes are normal — async TAs run outside Lambda with longer deadlines (must_gather: 30 min).

panels.title: DLQ Depth
panels.description: Visible messages on ZOA DLQ. Non-zero means worker/reconciler invocations failed and are not being retried.

panels.title: Executions by Cluster
panels.description: Total TA executions per cluster in the dashboard time range. Shows which RC/MC is busiest. Respects action filter.

panels.title: Executions by Status
panels.description: Total TA executions in the dashboard time range grouped by outcome. Respects cluster and action filters.

panels.title: Executions by Scope
panels.description: kube-api (K8s operations) vs aws-api (AWS operations) in the dashboard time range. Respects cluster and action filters.

panels.title: Executions by Type
panels.description: read (diagnostic) vs write (mutating) TAs in the dashboard time range. Respects cluster and action filters.

panels.title: Executions by Mode
panels.description: sync (in-Lambda) vs async (K8s Job) TAs in the dashboard time range. Respects cluster and action filters.

panels.title: Executions by Action & Status
panels.description: Breakdown of terminal TA executions by action name and outcome (succeeded/failed). Use to spot failing actions or unusual traffic patterns.

panels.title: P99 Execution Duration by Action
panels.description: Per-action P99 execution latency over time. Sync TAs should stay in seconds; async TAs (must_gather) in minutes. Spikes indicate degradation for that specific action.

panels.title: Rejections by Reason
panels.description: Cooldown, max concurrent, validation, action-not-found, circuit breaker. Expected traffic — do not page.

panels.title: Access request count by route & status
panels.description: Query A: session/boundary (start, join, exec-attached, terminate) — dimension_Cluster = target id, $cluster filter. Query B: laptop plane — health, version, targets, sessions (list + history) — dimension_Cluster = DEPLOYMENT_NAME.

panels.title: Access 5xx vs 4xx
panels.description: A/B session routes ($cluster). C/D deployment routes: health, version, targets, sessions (list and history share GET /api/v0/sessions).

panels.title: Access P99 HTTP request duration
panels.description: A session routes ($cluster). B deployment routes: health, version, targets, sessions (list + history).

panels.title: Boundary running tasks
panels.description: ECS/Container Insights TaskCount on {cluster_id}-zoa-boundary (RunTask sessions; no ECS service pending queue).

panels.title: Boundary task count (avg)
panels.description: Container Insights TaskCount average over the scrape window. Complements the max panel for bursty session load.

panels.title: Request Count by Route & Status
panels.description: API Lambda (HandlerMode=api). Function URL — route × status class.

panels.title: 5xx vs 4xx by Cluster
panels.description: 4xx includes cooldown and validation rejections (expected). 5xx means API unavailability.

panels.title: P99 HTTP Request Duration
panels.description: P99 latency of HTTP requests to the ZOA API Lambda Function URL. Includes dispatch overhead, not full execution time for async TAs.

panels.title: Worker tick duration
panels.description: Reconciler (60s), GC (5m), and reaper (5m) tick duration from EMF.

panels.title: Worker tick errors
panels.description: Phase errors per tick: reconciler, GC, reaper (session enforcement).

panels.title: Reconciler Tick Health
panels.description: Distinct ReconcilerLastRun values in the last 10 minutes (changes()). Reconciler fires every 60s. Expected: 3–4 (YACE scrapes every 120s → ~5 samples, ~4 transitions). 0 = stalled.

panels.title: GC Tick Health
panels.description: Distinct GCLastRun values in the last 30 minutes (changes()). GC fires every 5min. Expected: 4–6 (YACE scrapes every 120s → ~15 samples, ~6 GC ticks in window). 0 = stalled.

panels.title: Reaper Tick Health
panels.description: Distinct ReaperLastRun values in the last 30 minutes (changes()). Reaper fires every 5min. Expected: 4–6 (YACE scrapes every 120s → ~15 samples, ~6 reaper ticks in window). 0 = stalled.

panels.title: GC Cleaned Resources
panels.description: Ephemeral Kubernetes resources (ServiceAccounts, RBAC) cleaned up by the garbage collector. Empty is normal when no stale resources exist. Steady flow during activity means GC is healthy.

panels.title: Circuit Breaker State Changes
panels.description: Circuit breaker is per Lambda container, not global. Empty means healthy (no trips). A state=open event means at least one container cannot reach EKS.

panels.title: Identity Bridge Lookups
panels.description: All ResolveIdentity outcomes. **skipped** = laptop/e2e calling API without boundary (expected today). **hit/miss/error** = boundary task role only. Alert **ZOAIdentityBridgeHitRateBelowSLO** uses hit rate over hit|miss|error only.

panels.title: Boundary hit rate (excludes skipped)
panels.description: zoa:identity_bridge_hit_rate = hit / (hit+miss+error). Alert ZOAIdentityBridgeHitRateBelowSLO when below 95% with >10 boundary lookups. Graph skipped separately above — high skipped is normal for e2e/laptop→API.

panels.title: Lambda Invocations
panels.description: Raw Lambda invocations across ZOA functions (api + worker + access). Includes retries and scheduled events.

panels.title: Lambda Errors
panels.description: Lambda-level errors (unhandled exceptions, timeouts, OOM). Any non-zero value means requests were completely lost.

panels.title: Lambda Duration p99
panels.description: P99 Lambda execution time (wall clock). Approaching the Lambda timeout (300s) means code deadline or cold starts need investigation.

panels.title: DLQ Messages Visible
panels.description: Number of messages in the ZOA dead-letter queue over time. Each message represents a failed worker/reconciler Lambda invocation that exhausted retries.

panels.title: DLQ Oldest Message Age
panels.description: Age of the oldest DLQ message in seconds. Growing age means DLQ messages are not being investigated or replayed.

panels.title: ZOA Table Throttled Requests
panels.description: Should always be 0 with on-demand billing. Non-zero means DynamoDB is rejecting ZOA requests.

panels.title: ZOA Table Latency p99
panels.description: Tail latency of successful DynamoDB requests. Healthy is single-digit ms.

panels.title: ZOA Table Consumed Capacity
panels.description: Read and write capacity consumption. Sudden spikes can indicate unexpected load or table scans.
